rules: Every decoded label except X separators must match after case/spacing/punctuation normalization.
German umlauts map back to AE/OE/UE and sharp-s to SS; this is a display operation, not a source-coordinate change.
Unresolved plaintext positions remain one-for-one question marks. The native zero-unknown Telefunken inquiry separately declares its two grammatical question-mark offsets as readable punctuation.
No abbreviation expansion, inserted grammatical letter, digit interpretation or sender identification is permitted by this mapping.
The mapping proves preservation of the chosen edited text, not historical truth or uniqueness of its key/frame/word choices.
